holds_note: How each grip archetype HOLDS its weapon, read by blender/tools/pose_weapon_hold.py (authoring) and tools/godot/probe_weapon_fit.gd (the gate). The model is the CS / Left 4 Dead / GTA one: the weapon hangs from the firing hand at ONE socket per archetype, ONE upper-body clip set per archetype supplies the class of hold, the aim modifiers point the bore, and IK fits each WEAPON: `mount` puts a marker on the weapon at a body anchor (StockMountIKModifier: a butt pad in the shoulder pocket, a launcher tube on the shoulder), `support` puts the off hand's grip on the weapon's SupportPoint (SupportHandIKModifier). A new weapon of an existing archetype is markers only; a new archetype is one row here, one socket, one clip pair and a solve. `aim`/`hold` are the solve arguments the shipped clips were written with (CLAUDE.md W24/W25).
